scripts.prod:db: docker compose up -d --wait && (docker compose exec -T db psql -U hanoman -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE hanoman_prod' 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.prod:setup: pnpm prod:db && set -a && . ./.env.production && set +a && pnpm --filter ./server exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm build
scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./src build && pnpm --filter ./server build && node scripts/stamp-build.mjs
